observations.body: Fullness, circumcision, baptism, debt, and disarmed powers. Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ. Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

payload.posture: Read Colossians 2:8–15 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states fullness, circumcision, baptism, debt, and disarmed powers. Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ. Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
